Container.Name: wyoming-openai-hazel
Container.Overview: Wyoming bridge for Home Assistant voice: speech-to-text and text-to-speech from any OpenAI-compatible server (Whisper, Kokoro, ...). This is roryeckel/wyoming_openai plus tested, optional extras: early transcription (answer ready when Home Assistant decides you are done), sentence concurrency, voice display names and a GPU wake-up hook. Add it in Home Assistant with Settings > Devices & services > Add integration > Wyoming Protocol, port 10300. Raw TCP, no web page, no authentication: keep it on your LAN. New versions are published only after all tests pass, so the Docker tab shows 'update ready' only for tested releases.
Container.Requires: An OpenAI-compatible speech-to-text server and text-to-speech server (for example Whisper behind llama-swap and Kokoro-FastAPI).

Config.Name: Wyoming port
Config.Description: Wyoming protocol (raw TCP). Home Assistant connects here: Settings > Devices & services > Add integration > Wyoming Protocol.

Config.Name: STT_OPENAI_URL
Config.Description: OpenAI-compatible speech-to-text server (Whisper behind llama-swap, Speaches, ...). Ends in /v1.

Config.Name: STT_MODELS
Config.Description: Model id(s) the server lists, space separated.

Config.Name: STT_BACKEND
Config.Description: OPENAI is right for llama-swap and most servers; leave empty to auto-detect.

Config.Name: STT_EXTRA_BODY
Config.Description: Extra fields added to every transcription request, as JSON. Example: {"prompt": "Home Assistant commands. Kitchen, Poobot, BedJet"} makes Whisper spell your device names right.

Config.Name: TTS_OPENAI_URL
Config.Description: OpenAI-compatible text-to-speech server (Kokoro-FastAPI, Speaches, ...). Ends in /v1.

Config.Name: TTS_MODELS
Config.Description: Model id(s), space separated.

Config.Name: TTS_STREAMING_MODELS
Config.Description: Models that stream audio while they synthesize (reply starts after the first sentence).

Config.Name: TTS_VOICES
Config.Description: Voices offered to Home Assistant, space separated.

Config.Name: TTS_BACKEND
Config.Description: KOKORO_FASTAPI, OPENAI, SPEACHES or LOCALAI.

Config.Name: TTS_SPEED
Config.Description: Speaking speed for every voice (0.25 to 4.0). Empty = the server's default.

Config.Name: WYOMING_LANGUAGES
Config.Description: Languages offered to Home Assistant, space separated.

Config.Name: WYOMING_LOG_LEVEL
Config.Description: DEBUG logs every audio chunk.

Config.Name: HAZEL_STT_EARLY
Config.Description: 1 = start transcribing as soon as you pause for 0.3 s, so the answer is ready when Home Assistant decides you are done.

Config.Name: HAZEL_STT_EARLY_SILENCE_MS
Config.Description: Silence after speech that starts the early request.

Config.Name: HAZEL_TTS_CONCURRENCY
Config.Description: Sentences synthesized at the same time (empty = the original bridge's 3). 1 gets the first sentence to your ears soonest on a busy speech server.

Config.Name: HAZEL_TTS_VOICE_LABELS
Config.Description: Display names in Home Assistant's voice picker, id=Name;id2=Name2. Example: af_hazel=Hazel

Config.Name: HAZEL_GPU_WAKE_FILE
Config.Description: File to touch when a speech request starts (a helper on the GPU host can wake a sleeping card with it). Empty = off.

Config.Name: HAZEL_LOG_TIMING
Config.Description: Log how long speech-to-text and the first sound took.

Config.Name: TZ
Config.Description: Time zone for log lines.
